stem.text: Which pair of test results would prove that a substance, X, is a ketone?

A.text: X has no reaction with Tollens’ reagent. X reacts with alkaline aqueous iodine.

B.text: X is reduced by lithium aluminium hydride. X is oxidised by acidified dichromate(VI).

C.text: X reacts with 2,4-DNPH reagent. X has no reaction with Fehling’s reagent.

D.text: X reacts with hydrogen cyanide. X is reduced by lithium aluminium hydride.
